propositions: A git merge abort triggered by local working-tree changes to tracked files leaves reconverge unable to advance and strands local ticket commits off origin.

Tracked file deletions from interrupted compaction folds (staged deletions via git add -A) cause merge failure with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge' signature.
The recovery mechanism must parse merge-abort error messages to identify tracked paths, restore deletions non-destructively from HEAD via git checkout, and quarantine modifications before restore.
A single retry of the merge after restoring tracked-file state should complete successfully; genuine index/content conflicts abort and keep local state unchanged.
